task:
UI redesign phase 2b — M09 on-demand map window with Show on map / Expand / Close, state preservation and the existing canvas (plan: `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-02-v3-ui-redesign-plan.md`, on main, §4 row P2b and "Phase 2 — map workspace (M09)"). START from current `main` (P2a #1005 — `explore-view-state.svelte.ts` + `explore-result-cache.ts`, one `ExploreViewState` per route visit passed as a prop; P3 #1006 Finder polish; design kit #998 are merged; P6a home polish is an open PR touching only `routes/+page.svelte`/`app.css` — do not touch home). apps/web only; no backend, route, API-request, renderer-algorithm, scene-contract or layer-provenance change.

OWNER DECISIONS (2026-11-03) — record these in the plan doc §7 as decided, in the same PR: (1) Phone Explore layout: after Show on map the window fills the available workspace; Close restores the results exactly (scroll, selection, filters, query). (2) Mobile modality: NON-modal at every width (no focus trap, no inert background); Close, Escape and focus return are required. (3) Count exposure: keep all 19 count controls (not part of this PR; P3 already respects it). (4) Explore task tabs: approved as Finder / Saved / Compare — that is P2c, NOT this PR; do not add tabs here. (5) Visual reference: none handed over yet — do not claim pixel fidelity; placement follows the plan's description only.

WHAT TO BUILD:
1. New `apps/web/src/lib/features/explore/ExploreMapWindow.svelte` (kit pop-out/window skin as used by the Inspect evidence pop-out and Plan Review & export; registered in `lib/components/popout-stack.ts` so topmost-Escape and layer order are shared) that EMBEDS the existing `SpatialCanvas.svelte` with its existing renderer-neutral camera/selection interface and Babylon runtime. The Galaxy context stays ONE logical thing: window visibility is presentation. Exactly one `SpatialCanvas` instance exists per Explore route visit at any time; when the window is closed the canvas is suspended/unmounted and all its CPU-side state (camera, layer toggles, stream camera/detail mode, viewport, selected/hovered ids, reserved points, density/nebula receipts) lives in the P2a `ExploreViewState`, so reopening restores a meaningful camera/layer context without a second runtime, duplicate subscriptions, duplicate queries or leaked GPU resources (dispose on close; prove no leak in tests via the managed-runtime/disposal hooks the lifecycle tests already use).
2. Controls in `ExploreWorkspace.svelte`: **Show on map** on the selected result (and on the scope/anchor row when a system is selected) opens the window focused on that system using the existing camera-request path; **Expand** gives the same window the full workspace (desktop: the results column collapses to a narrow rail or hides; phone: already full per decision 1); **Close** (button + Escape when topmost) restores the previous layout, result-list scroll position, selection, filters and query, and returns focus to the control that opened the window. Reopen retains camera/layers. Only an explicit search action changes the search — opening, expanding, closing or resizing must not issue a search, catalogue, density or nebula request beyond what the existing viewport streaming does when the canvas is visible (viewport streaming/density/nebula requests are suspended while the window is closed).
3. Keep inside the window: Layers pop-out, camera controls (+/−/rotate/Up/Down/Top down/Tilted/Reset view), hover cards and their keyboard equivalents, region select/View selected, the range/grid readout, Finder/catalogue star separation, viewport streaming, density and nebula layers, scope/radius behaviour and deliberate System entry/return. Retain actual coordinates and regions; missing coordinates stay unavailable.
4. Desktop default (window closed): search/archetype/results stay usable together using the width the map used to take — results column may widen; do not change the Finder controls just polished in P3 beyond layout wiring. Keyboard docking/resize is NOT required in this PR unless cheap; topmost Escape, focus return and reduced motion (no camera fly animation when `prefers-reduced-motion`) ARE required.
5. URL/storage: window open/expanded state is view state (P2a helper), not URL; do not add persisted keys. Existing URLs stay readable.

TESTS: `ExploreWorkspace.test.ts` + `ExploreWorkspace.workload.test.ts` (Show/Expand/Close/reopen: single canvas instance, request counts unchanged by open/close/expand, scroll/selection/filter/query retention, focus return, Escape only when topmost, reduced-motion camera), `ExploreMapWindow.test.ts`, `MapLayers.test.ts`, spatial component/lifecycle tests (suspend/rebuild preserves CPU state; disposal verified; no duplicate subscriptions). Product `product-journey.cy.ts` and `spatial-foundation.cy.ts`: Show on map → Expand → Close → reopen, tab switch retention, scroll retention, resize, topmost Escape, focus return, axe and reduced motion at desktop and 390×844; keep runtime bounded; adjust existing map selectors to the window without loosening assertions; keep `tests/test_v3_product_journey_contract.py` pins updated where wording intentionally changes. Review Lab's injected map failure/recovery scenarios must still pass inside the window. Update plan doc §4 row P2b to "implemented in this PR", §7 decisions 1–4 to decided (with the 2026-11-03 answers above), and add a dated CHANGES.md entry (`## 2026-11-03 — UI redesign P2b: on-demand map window (M09)`, newest first; the log uses dated headings, not an Unreleased section).

RULES: pnpm 11.25.0, `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`, then `pnpm check`, `pnpm lint`, `pnpm format:check`, `pnpm test`, `pnpm build` must all pass before you push (run `pnpm format` if needed); run the Python contract tests you touched. Tokens only in styles (`design-kit.test.ts`). Do not touch `frontend/`, backend, sql/, workflows, deploy/, scripts/ or `routes/+page.svelte`. Do not create a flat `apps/web/src/lib/api.ts`. No new dependencies. Keep the F4 flag and its recovery path exactly as they are. If the window cannot be complete in one PR, put the incomplete surface behind a separate default-off UI flag with both paths tested (never reuse the F4 flag) and say so in the PR body. In the PR body: list the state fields the window reads/writes in `ExploreViewState`, paste the before/after request counts from the workload tests, and state how single-runtime ownership and GPU disposal are proven.
